expectations.text: Sizes the advice to a small product and does not demand a large operations setup
expectations.evidence: "you don't need a full monitoring stack"; skip dashboards, paging rotations

expectations.text: Recommends a health check and error capture and backups as basics
expectations.evidence: /health endpoint, Sentry, automatic backups with test restore

expectations.text: Makes the point that detection and alerting must reach a person
expectations.evidence: Pinger emailing or texting you; "a short note on who gets alerted"

expectations.text: Does not claim anything is working without evidence
expectations.evidence: "I have not looked at your code or hosting setup, so this is general advice"
